hypotheses.latent_object: F(z) = f(z), where f is the declared unary function
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: A_i = O_i[F]; G0002 substitutes z->x in F, G0003 substitutes z->y in F, and G0001 combines these substitutions as (F(x)+F(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: f is an uninterpreted unary function
x and y are distinct formal symbols for which the denominator x-y is nonzero
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: G0002 and G0003 are evaluations of the same unary function f at distinct formal points x and y; G0001 is a rational combination of those evaluations divided by the coordinate difference. This is a structural master-function representation, not a physical interpretation.
